text:
BMO Field malitere iwu na March 29, 2006 ma mepee na April 28, 2007, e wuru ya dị ka ụlọ egwuregwu bọọlụ maka 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup na dị ka ebe obibi mbụ nke Toronto FC. Ego e ji wuo ya bụ CA$62.9 nde, Brisbin Brooks Beynon Architects haziri ya.

E ji FieldTurf kpuchie ala ya site na 2007 ruo 2009, ihe e ji kpuchie ala nke dọtara nkatọ ndị egwuregwu. A gbanwere ya ka ọ bụrụ Kentucky bluegrass tupu oge 2010, ma emesịa bụrụ usoro ahịhịa ngwakọta site na 2019.

Mmezi ukwu nke Gensler haziri sochiri na 2014–2016, na-efu ihe dị ka CA$120 nde. Ọ gbakwụnyere elu ụlọ ọwụwa anyanwụ nke ihe dị ka oche 8,400, e mechara na May 2015, tinyere okpu n’elu ụlọ ọwụwa anyanwụ, ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda na ogige ogologo maka bọọlụ Canada. Ọrụ ndị a welitere ikike bọọlụ site na ihe dị ka 21,566 ruo ihe dị ka 30,000.

Njirimara ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ gbasaa karịa bọọlụ mgbe ndị CFL Toronto Argonauts kwagara ebe ahụ maka oge 2016. Na mgbakwunye na nhazi ya nke oche 28,180, ebe ahụ anabatala asọmpi ikpeazụ na egwuregwu ngosi, na-egosipụta ọnọdụ ya dị ka ebe obibi bọọlụ mba.

Bank of Montreal nwere ikike aha dị ka BMO Field, mana a na-akpọ ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ Toronto Stadium nwa oge maka 2026 World Cup n’okpuru iwu FIFA nke ebe dị ọcha — dị ka a kpọrọ ya National Soccer Stadium maka asọmpi 2007 na 2014 FIFA. Maka 2026 World Cup ọ na-anabata egwuregwu isii: egwuregwu otu ise tinyere otu egwuregwu Round of 32 na July 2, 2026, n’etiti ha bụ egwuregwu mmeghe nke Canada na June 12, 2026. A haziri ikike ya maka asọmpi ahụ na 43,036.
